body.text: Birth of Chaos Goals: Teach how Busta entered the game. “Why does his verse feel like a cartoon explosion compared to the others?”

items: Early exposure to dancehall + patois cadences
Leaders of the New School (LONS) → youthful energy
Early standout moments on posse cuts
The legendary “Scenario” verse where the world first said “oh yeah, HE different”
